title: Gnarly surface colors
description: Real-world colors for one zone, projected from scan photos onto RoomPlan surfaces. Identifiers match scan-features.json. The texture atlas is the sibling file named by `atlas`.

atlas.description: JPEG atlas file name, normally surface-colors.jpg.

texelMeters.description: Approximate size of one atlas texel on the surface.

usedLidarDepth.description: True when LiDAR depth was used to reject occluded photo samples.

face.description: Faces use three.js BoxGeometry names in the feature's local frame. Planar surfaces (walls, doors, windows, floors) have only pz and nz; objects also have px, nx and py. U/V axes: pz U=+x V=+y, nz U=-x V=+y, px U=-z V=+y, nx U=+z V=+y, py U=+x V=-z.

color.description: Average sRGB color of the face.

coverage.description: Fraction of the face seen in at least one photo.

rect.description: Atlas pixels [x, y, width, height] from the top-left. The rect's top row is v = 1 and u runs along the face's U axis. Absent when coverage was too low for a texture; use `color` instead.
